reason: Reproduced: the stacked bar segments (the named group is a zero-height Aug segment, 0.012px tall) respond to a click by isolating one series, and neither they nor the chart svg have a tabindex, so Tab never reaches them. The Uncategorized legend button does the same on Enter (aria-pressed true, others hidden, same chart as the click), so no task needs a mouse. The sweep xpath crosses the svg, which document.evaluate and the probe cannot resolve, so I matched the group by its rect.

Reproduced: Tab skips Show stacked bar chart, because the selected segment has tabindex=-1. But Enter on it changes nothing (same URL, same chart), the other three segments are reachable, and after Enter on Show sankey chart the stacked bar button is back in the tab order. Keyboard users lose no function.
criterionAnalysis: 2.1.1 requires all functionality to be operable by keyboard. The only control Tab skips is the one for the mode already showing; activating it is a no-op, and switching to the stacked bar chart by keyboard works from any other mode. 2.4.3 focus order stays logical (line chart, then sankey). 4.1.2 name and role are exposed (button "Show stacked bar chart"). That the selected mode is not announced is a different claim from this finding and was not evaluated here.
